suppress.notes: Netty 4.1.121.Final: HTTP/2 + codec CVEs. TLS terminated at K8s ingress; no inbound raw Netty; outbound async HTTP to card-service only. BOM-managed; no upgrade path without Spring Boot bump.
angus-mail 2.0.3: SMTP client CVE. App connects only to admin-controlled relays (MailHog dev / app.yml SMTP host in prod).
angus-mail 2.0.3 shaded angus-core: same SMTP CVE reasoning.
jakarta.mail 2.0.3: SMTP client CVE. Admin-controlled relay only.
jakarta.mail 2.0.3 shaded logging-mailhandler: same SMTP CVE.
spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server 3.5.0: actuator CVEs. Actuator restricted to authorized users; Keycloak JWT used (no token relay). BOM-managed; no patched 3.5.x available.
spring-security-core 6.5.0: security header CVEs. Headers also enforced at K8s ingress and Vercel edge. BOM-managed; no patched 6.5.x.
spring-core 6.2.7: framework CVEs. BOM-managed; no patched 6.2.x.
pdfbox 3.0.3: XML/parsing CVEs. Used for report PDF generation only; no untrusted external PDFs parsed. Vulnerable parsing paths never reached.
poi 5.3.0: OLE2/parsing CVE. Used for XLSX report generation only; no untrusted external Office files parsed.
postgresql JDBC 42.7.5: JDBC URL CVE. BOM-managed; JDBC params are admin-controlled; no user-supplied JDBC URLs accepted.
commons-lang3 3.17.0: false positive CPE match. Utility library with no network-facing code.
log4j-api 2.24.3: false positive. log4j-api is a facade only; log4j-core is not present. Logging implementation is Logback via SLF4J.
keycloak-admin-client 26.0.5: server-side CVEs. The admin client JAR only calls the Keycloak Admin REST API; it does not include or run server-side code. False positive CPE match.
